short_description: Consolidate inbound studio enquiries, qualify budget & fit, schedule discovery calls, and handle non-fit leads.

questions.question: Which channels generate enquiries and where are they consolidated?
What information is needed to assess service fit, budget, timing and decision authority?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Project scope, target launch window, indicative budget range, key stakeholder...

questions.question: Who reviews new leads and how quickly?
options: Founder / new-business lead reviews same business day
Account manager reviews when checking inbox
No fixed SLA — depends on busyness

questions.question: What qualification criteria are used and where are exceptions recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Minimum project budget and core service match; exceptions noted in CRM...

questions.question: How are discovery calls scheduled and prepared?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Calendar link sent after brief form; team reviews brand website before call...

questions.question: How is the lead outcome and next action recorded?
options: CRM stage updated with clear next task & date
Notes in Slack / Google Doc; proposals drafted manually

questions.question: What happens to leads that are not ready, not suitable or unresponsive?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Polite decline or tagged for 60-day check-in; often forgotten if quiet...

short_description: Verify signed scope and deposit, collect brand assets & logins, set up project workspace, and align delivery.

questions.question: What confirms that a client is ready to move from sales into delivery?
options: Verbal / email go-ahead while contract is finalised

questions.question: What scope, deliverables, exclusions, deadlines and approval terms are recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Number of revision rounds, milestone dates, out-of-scope rules in SOW...

questions.question: How are agreement and initial payment status confirmed before work begins?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Finance or founder checks bank/Stripe and pings producer in Slack...

questions.question: What client inputs, brand assets, access and references are collected?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Brand guidelines, logos, CMS/ad account logins, audience notes...

questions.question: Who checks that the brief and assets are complete?
options: Producer / project manager runs kickoff readiness checklist
Designers/devs discover missing assets after starting work

questions.question: How are project tasks, owners, deadlines and communication channels created?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Producer duplicates template in Asana/ClickUp, creates Drive folder & Slack channel...

questions.question: What information is lost or re-requested during the sales-to-delivery handoff?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Discovery call context, verbal promises on speed, or asset links buried in emails...

short_description: Turn client requests into complete briefs, schedule capacity, manage QA, and control client feedback & versions.

questions.question: How does a request become an approved brief?
options: Structured brief form reviewed by account lead/producer before creative starts
Client emails or Slacks request straight to creative team

questions.question: What makes a brief complete enough for production to start?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Objective, target format/specs, copy/assets attached, due date, approver...

questions.question: Who assigns the work and confirms capacity, dependencies and due dates?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Producer / creative director checks studio workload weekly...

questions.question: What internal quality checks happen before client review?
options: Creative director / peer QA against brief checklist
Quick Slack glance when time allows
Sent straight to client by creator

questions.question: How is client feedback collected and consolidated?
options: Visual review tool (Frame.io / Figma / Markup) with single consolidated pass
Scattered emails, Slack messages, and comments from multiple stakeholders

questions.question: How are revision rounds, scope changes and final approval controlled?
questions.placeholder: e.g. 2 included rounds tracked by account manager; extra changes quoted...

questions.question: Who confirms delivery or publishing and records the final asset/version?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Account manager sends final files link and archives approved vFINAL folder...

short_description: Gather multi-channel metrics, validate data, add strategic commentary, review quality, and track next-cycle actions.

questions.question: Which channels or systems provide performance data?
Who collects the data and how are reporting periods defined?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Account coordinator pulls numbers on 1st–3rd business day of each month...

questions.question: What checks confirm data is complete and comparable?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Compare platform spend against invoices and check tracking tags...

questions.question: Who interprets performance and adds context for the client?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Strategist / account manager writes insights and next-month recommendations...

questions.question: Who reviews the report before it is shared?
options: Account director / senior strategist QA review
No separate review — coordinator sends directly

questions.question: How are client decisions and agreed actions captured?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Recap email after monthly review call lists client approvals and agency tasks...

questions.question: How are actions tracked and fed into the next reporting cycle?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Added to project board and reviewed at top of next month's report...
